messages.author: e6c87266ffc5f0f2
messages.subject: order results ignored
parts:
Hello,

I use the following to order my data.

df <- df[order(df$p,decreasing=T), ]

When I then plot the data as bar plot, it somehow ignores the new
order. I assume this is because ggplot2 accesses the data frame per
row instead of the order. Is there a way around this problem, please?

Thanks.

messages.author: da9c12edf6cde6a8
messages.subject: Re: order results ignored
parts:
For a given factor, say df$name, you can reorder for example like this:

df$name <- factor(df$name,
levels=c("Max out degree","Max impact",
"Min out degree","Min impact")
)

After that, ggplot2 uses the new order of df$name ...


With ezLev its almost the same length of code. So I do not see the
nessecity for using an extra package like ez:

df$name <- ezLev(
x=df$name,
new_order=c("Max out degree","Max impact",
"Min out degree","Min impact")
)

Rainer Hurling
